title: Garden view 00, roof-depth sensitivity
camera_definition: See south-garden-two-photographs.json. Coordinates are [east from bay centre, depth out from south wall, Z above datum]. Tracked roof features beyond the garden plane change with focal length. A garden-side observation and the ridge height seen from Wuyi Road constrain a family of possible cameras.
limits: The 525 and 650 pixel focal lengths are sensitivity trials, not EXIF measurements. Apparent close agreement of the eave lines in two views depends on the assumed setback. The absolute roof heights, hip depth and chimney stations are estimated.
